name: Wall of Ghosts
body:
School necromancy [fear, mind-affecting]; Level bloodlord 5, death mage 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M/DF (a small block of wood)

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Effect wall of spirits whose area is up to one 10-ft. square/level, or a sphere or hemisphere with a radius of up to 1 ft./level

Duration 1 min./level (d)

Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance no

An immobile, swirling wall of groaning spirits springs into existence. On one side of the wall, selected by you, emits a disturbing groan that causes creatures within 60 feet to be panicked for 1d4 rounds. A successful Will save negates the panicked. Any living creature that touches or passes through the wall takes 1d10 negative energy damage. Those passing through must also make a Fortitude save or gain one negative level. The wall provides total concealment.
